resources.string: Dictation quota used up for now; try again later

Rambler Bubble needs this to type your dictated words into the text field you are using. Android offers no other way to insert text into another app. After you dictate, it finds the focused text field and puts the words at the cursor. It does not read your screen, record what you type or watch other apps, and it sends nothing anywhere.
Rambler Bubble is not affiliated with Google. Your dictation audio is sent to Google servers, through a service Google has not opened to third-party apps. It may stop working at any time.
